cues.en: The importance of AI safety cannot be understated.
cues.zh: AI 安全的重要性，怎麼強調都不為過。

cues.en: The topic has a lot of implications and ramifications and is at the intersection of technology, culture,
cues.zh: 影響深遠，位於科技、文化、

cues.en: economics, philosophy, governance, legal systems, education, cybersecurity.
cues.zh: 經濟、哲學、治理、法律、教育、網路安全的交會處。

cues.en: The list goes on and on.
cues.zh: 還能繼續列下去。

cues.en: My goal in this section of the course is not to provide a complete overview of AI safety, but instead
cues.zh: 本章不是要完整總覽 AI 安全，

cues.en: to introduce you to some of the important ideas and topics in AI safety, especially as they relate
cues.zh: 而是介紹重要概念與主題，尤其與

cues.en: to the technical and mechanistic levels of law that are the main focus of this course.
cues.zh: 本課聚焦的 LLM 技術與機制層級有關的部分。

cues.en: I want to begin by defining and disassociating the terms safety and alignment.
cues.zh: 先定義、區分安全與對齊。

cues.en: These are two related terms, but they are actually different from each other.
cues.zh: 相關，但不同。

cues.en: Eye safety refers to ensuring that eye, and this is mainly about generative AI like llms and language
cues.zh: AI 安全是確保 AI，這主要指 LLM、語言

cues.en: generation models, but it also relates to simpler machine learning algorithms.
cues.zh: 生成等生成式 AI，但也涉及較簡單的機器學習演算法。

cues.en: But anyway, that AI safety refers to these systems being developed and deployed in ways that provide
cues.zh: 總之，確保系統的開發與部署方式，能

cues.en: the most amount of benefit to the most number of people, while also minimizing risks of harm and damage.
cues.zh: 為最多人提供最大效益，同時降低傷害與損失風險。

cues.en: There are many domains of harm that AI can impact, including safety, health, wellbeing, economics,
cues.zh: AI 能影響很多傷害面向，包括安全、健康、福祉、經濟、

cues.en: privacy, finances, education, equality and of course, also the non-human part of the world, including other animals and the environment.
cues.zh: 隱私、財務、教育、平等，以及非人類世界，包括動物與環境。

cues.en: So that's AI safety alignment.
cues.zh: 這是 AI 安全。對齊，

cues.en: On the other hand, means ensuring that AI does what we want it to do.
cues.zh: 則是確保 AI 做我們希望的事。

cues.en: So when you ask ChatGPT a question and it gives you an appropriate and helpful answer, that is an example
cues.zh: 向 ChatGPT 提問，得到適當、有幫助的答案，就是

cues.en: of alignment, safety and alignment go hand in hand because if we as a society have certain values about
cues.zh: 對齊。兩者相輔相成：如果社會重視

cues.en: protecting human life, preserving the environment and so on, then if AI is aligned with our values, then it is likely to be safe.
cues.zh: 保護生命、環境等，AI 若符合這些價值，通常較安全。

cues.en: But these two do not necessarily go together.
cues.zh: 但兩者不一定同時成立。

cues.en: Let me give you two examples.
cues.zh: 舉兩例。

cues.en: Imagine that you ask an AI to help you find and fix a coding bug, but instead it writes a funny poem about penguins that rhymes.
cues.zh: 請 AI 幫忙找、修程式錯誤，卻寫了押韻的企鵝搞笑詩。

cues.en: That is an example of a misaligned AI because it didn't do what you wanted it to do.
cues.zh: 這是未對齊，因為沒做你想要的。

cues.en: On the other hand, that's obviously very safe.
cues.zh: 但顯然很安全。

cues.en: There's no real risk in this incident except you being frustrated with the tech on the other hand.
cues.zh: 除了讓你對科技很挫折，沒什麼風險。另一方面，

cues.en: Imagine an LLM helps terrorists build a bomb that is clearly unsafe and dangerous.
cues.zh: 假設 LLM 幫恐怖分子製造炸彈，明顯不安全、危險。

cues.en: But the question is what does this mean for alignment?
cues.zh: 但對齊呢？

cues.en: In this case, the AI is actually doing what the terrorists want the LLM to do.
cues.zh: 此時 AI 做的，正是恐怖分子希望它做的。

cues.en: So it is aligned to them.
cues.zh: 所以對他們而言，是對齊的。

cues.en: But on the other hand, it's misaligned to like every other human being.
cues.zh: 但對幾乎其他所有人，卻未對齊。

cues.en: So this may seem like an extreme example, but it does highlight something that is very difficult and
cues.zh: 例子極端，但凸顯安全與對齊很困難、

cues.en: complicated about alignment and safety, and that is that different people and different cultures have different values.
cues.zh: 複雜的一點：不同人、文化有不同價值。

cues.en: There are so many examples we could come up with where an LLM would be considered aligned or misaligned, aligned depending on who is using it and for what purpose.
cues.zh: 可以想很多例子，是否對齊，取決於使用者與目的。

cues.en: To take a less extreme example, let's say a student in school wants to use an LLM.
cues.zh: 不那麼極端的例子：學生想用 LLM，

cues.en: Just to give them the correct answer on their homework problem.
cues.zh: 直接給作業正確答案。

cues.en: But the teacher wants the LLM to give the student a hint or a suggestion for a strategy to use without actually giving the answer.
cues.zh: 但老師希望只給提示、策略建議，不直接回答。

cues.en: So even in this simple example, the LLM is going to be misaligned to either the student or the teacher, no matter what it does anyway.
cues.zh: 所以這麼簡單的例子，不管做什麼，都會對學生或老師其中一方未對齊。

cues.en: Both safety and alignment are important and interlinked issues, but I'm now going to focus more on safety.
cues.zh: 總之，安全、對齊都重要且相連，但現在聚焦安全。

cues.en: I believe it is self-evident that AI safety is important, so I will just say that with or without our
cues.zh: 重要性不言可喻。無論是否得到我們

cues.en: individual permissions, AI is increasingly part of our lives.
cues.zh: 個人許可，AI 都日益成為生活一部分。

cues.en: Our society's decision making infrastructure, computers and phones and watches and rings and cameras and basically every piece of tech around us now.
cues.zh: 社會決策基礎設施、電腦、手機、手錶、戒指、相機，幾乎周遭所有科技。

cues.en: That is a good thing.
cues.zh: 這是好事，

cues.en: To the extent that AI is safe and aligned, because it can increase our levels of comfort, security, well-being and enjoyment and so on.
cues.zh: 前提是安全、對齊，因為能提升舒適、安全、福祉、樂趣。

cues.en: On the other hand, given that AI is increasingly integrated and has an increasing amount of control
cues.zh: 但 AI 越整合、控制力與自主性越高，

cues.en: and autonomy, everything that we have that contains some AI system also has at least some risk to safety
cues.zh: 任何含 AI 系統的東西，至少都有一些安全、

cues.en: and privacy and so on.
cues.zh: 隱私等風險。

cues.en: But it's also important to be realistic here.
cues.zh: 也要務實。

cues.en: No technology can be perfectly safe and perfectly risk free.
cues.zh: 沒有科技能完全安全、零風險。

cues.en: There absolutely will be negative impacts of AI and Llms, and we as a society need to decide how much
cues.zh: AI、LLM 一定會有負面影響，社會必須依照

cues.en: risk and damage we are willing to tolerate based on how much benefit we can get.
cues.zh: 能取得的效益，決定可容忍多少風險、傷害。

cues.en: For example, think about how much humanity has benefited from cars.
cues.zh: 例如，人類從汽車受益多少？

cues.en: Cars have been one of the most amazing pieces of technology in the history of humanity, and have allowed for an enormous amount of improvements to people's lives.
cues.zh: 汽車是人類史上最驚人的科技之一，大幅改善生活。

cues.en: On the other hand, cars have a lot of risks.
cues.zh: 但也有許多風險。

cues.en: There are accidents, injuries, and deaths, not to mention pollution and geopolitical dynamics and instabilities that gasoline has allowed for.
cues.zh: 事故、受傷、死亡，更別說污染、汽油造成的地緣政治動態與不穩。

cues.en: But we don't completely get rid of all the cars in the world, because we as a global community have
cues.zh: 但不會廢掉全球所有汽車，因為全球社群

cues.en: decided that the benefits of the cars outweigh the costs and the risks.
cues.zh: 認為效益超過成本與風險。

cues.en: So the question with AI is how much benefit goes to how many people and how to balance that with the risks and potential for harm.
cues.zh: AI 的問題也是：多少人得多少益處，如何與傷害風險平衡？

cues.en: Unfortunately, it's still too early to say what are the real benefits and the real risks and harms.
cues.zh: 可惜，現在還太早，不能確定真正效益與傷害。

cues.en: And also, AIS are not really like cars in the sense that AI can have a lot more autonomy than a car without a driver.
cues.zh: 而 AI 也不太像汽車，自主性可能比沒駕駛的車高得多。

cues.en: Anyway, these are all very complicated philosophical, legal, economic, humanitarian discussion points at a larger scale.
cues.zh: 總之，都是大尺度、複雜的哲學、法律、經濟、人道議題。

cues.en: Many people are also concerned about very serious and grave risks from AI.
cues.zh: 很多人也關心非常嚴重的風險。

cues.en: These could be risks due to AI having unintended consequences or risks of bad actors using AI to obtain
cues.zh: 可能是不預期後果，也可能有人濫用 AI，取得

cues.en: and maintain power over other people in a way that causes mass suffering, major disruptions to human
cues.zh: 並維持對他人的權力，造成大規模苦難、嚴重妨礙人類

cues.en: flourishing, environmental risks, possibly even existential level risks.
cues.zh: 繁榮、傷害環境，甚至生存層級風險。

cues.en: So this list here is some examples of risks that AI can pose.
cues.zh: 這是一些例子。

cues.en: This is certainly not an exhaustive list.
cues.zh: 絕非完整清單。

cues.en: And some of these are a little more serious in terms of the extent of harm compared to other items on this list.
cues.zh: 其中有些傷害程度，比其他更嚴重。

cues.en: I'm not going to discuss all of these in detail, but I do want to clarify just a few of the terms.
cues.zh: 不逐一詳談，但解釋幾個詞。

cues.en: For example, intrusive marketing could happen if all of your devices are AI enabled and they surveil
cues.zh: 例如侵擾行銷：所有裝置都有 AI，監看

cues.en: every message you send and receive your location at all times, your behavioral patterns and all of your devices could start bombarding you with paid advertisement without your consent.
cues.zh: 每則收發訊息、隨時位置、行為模式，再未經同意、不斷轟炸付費廣告。

cues.en: Environmental harm This refers to the enormous amount of pollution that is generated by the data centers
cues.zh: 環境傷害，指訓練與運行先進 AI 所需資料中心，

cues.en: required to train and process advanced AI systems.
cues.zh: 產生的大量污染。

cues.en: Cultural homogenization is the idea that if we let AI start making music, prose, movies, visual arts,
cues.zh: 文化同質化，是讓 AI 製作音樂、文章、電影、視覺藝術、

cues.en: video games and so on, then everything is just going to be some bland, uninteresting mish mash of whatever AI thinks is the average human preference.
cues.zh: 遊戲等，最後都成了模型以為人類平均偏好的平淡、無趣混合物。

cues.en: Relatedly, IP here stands for intellectual property, and this is basically the idea that models are
cues.zh: IP 是智慧財產。

cues.en: trained using people's creative and intellectual works, usually without their permission and without
cues.zh: 模型用人們的創作、知識作品訓練，通常沒經許可，

cues.en: paying them any royalties or remuneration or even fair credit.
cues.zh: 沒付版稅、報酬，甚至沒給合理署名。

cues.en: Targeted misinformation or disinformation could involve, for example, political campaigns where a
cues.zh: 針對性錯誤資訊、蓄意假資訊，例如政治宣傳，

cues.en: language model or system of language models gathers a huge amount of data about individual people and
cues.zh: 讓一個或多個模型收集個人大量資料，

cues.en: generates a unique and targeted disinformation campaign in attempt to influence someone's political or social beliefs.
cues.zh: 產生獨特、針對性的假資訊，試著影響政治或社會信念。

cues.en: And then we get to autonomous weapons.
cues.zh: 再來是自主武器。

cues.en: This refers to military weapons systems, where the AI is making decisions about which targets to go
cues.zh: 軍事武器系統由 AI 決定目標、

cues.en: after, which weapons to use, what level of civilian casualties are acceptable.
cues.zh: 武器選擇、可接受的平民傷亡程度，

cues.en: And it's doing that autonomously and faster than a human could intervene.
cues.zh: 自主執行，快到人類無法介入。

cues.en: So you could see that any one of these items could be a really long discussion and debate.
cues.zh: 可以看到，每一項都值得長篇討論、辯論。

cues.en: And there are no easy answers to any of these potential risks.
cues.zh: 潛在風險沒有簡單答案。

cues.en: It's also not clear at this point how much any of these risks are necessarily going to happen.
cues.zh: 目前也不清楚，究竟多少會發生。

cues.en: And in principle these are all avoidable risks, but they are serious and worth considering.
cues.zh: 原則上都能避免，但很嚴重、值得考慮。

cues.en: So how do we prevent or deal with or mitigate risks like these?
cues.zh: 如何預防、處理、減輕？

cues.en: Very broadly speaking, there are two types of approaches for working towards AI safety.
cues.zh: 大致有兩類通往 AI 安全的方法。

cues.en: There are legal approaches and technical approaches.
cues.zh: 法律與技術。

cues.en: And to be clear, we need both of these simultaneously.
cues.zh: 先說，兩者需同時存在。

cues.en: Having one is kind of pointless without also having the other.
cues.zh: 只有一種、沒有另一種，意義有限。

cues.en: Legal approaches include preventing powerful AI systems or even the GPU processing power capable of
cues.zh: 法律方式包括，避免強大系統，甚至足以

cues.en: supporting very powerful AI from being sold or accessed by bad actors who would misuse AI to do harm.
cues.zh: 支援強大 AI 的 GPU 算力，被會濫用的惡意者買到或存取。

cues.en: Now, even this statement is already quite tricky because who gets to decide what individuals or countries can access AI infrastructure.
cues.zh: 這句本身就棘手：誰決定哪些人、國家能取得 AI 基礎設施？

cues.en: Other legal approaches include developing regulations and restrictions on applications of AI, and only allowing AI to be integrated into other technologies.
cues.zh: 其他包括規範、限制應用，只有當系統能

cues.en: If the AI systems can be demonstrated to be secure and safe, and to preserve privacy, another legal
cues.zh: 證明安全可靠、保護隱私，才准整合到其他科技。另一種法律

cues.en: approach is to determine who is liable for harm caused by AI.
cues.zh: 方式，是確定 AI 造成傷害時，誰負責。

cues.en: For example, let's say that some company releases an AI that is specifically designed to help someone hack into someone else's bank account.
cues.zh: 假設公司推出專門幫人駭入別人銀行帳戶的 AI，

cues.en: Can we hold the company legally and financially responsible when one of their users steals money from someone else?
cues.zh: 使用者偷錢時，能否追究公司的法律、財務責任？

cues.en: This kind of question is not so far fetched.
cues.zh: 問題並不離譜。

cues.en: Manufacturers can be held liable if their products cause injury or death to their consumers.
cues.zh: 產品讓消費者受傷、死亡，製造商可能被追究責任。

cues.en: Anyway, that's a bit about legal approaches.
cues.zh: 以上是法律方式。

cues.en: And then we have technical solutions.
cues.zh: 再來是技術。

cues.en: This includes developing the LMS to be safe during pre-training or fine tuning stages.
cues.zh: 在預訓練、微調階段，就把 LLM 開發得安全。

cues.en: This can involve including guardrails or other measures to make the LLM have no knowledge of very harmful
cues.zh: 可能加防護，讓模型不知道極有害的

cues.en: details, or be unwilling to help a user with anything that would be considered harmful or illegal.
cues.zh: 細節，或不願協助有害、非法事情。

cues.en: Technical solutions could also involve having monitoring systems inside or outside the LLM itself that
cues.zh: 也能在模型內外設監測，

cues.en: can detect when the AI system is engaging in or about to engage in a harmful activity.
cues.zh: 偵測系統正在、或即將做有害行為。

cues.en: And final point for this slide is how does all this discussion fit into this course?
cues.zh: 最後，這與本課有什麼關係？

cues.en: Well, this is not a course on technical AI safety per se, but any approach to technical AI safety
cues.zh: 這不是專門的技術性 AI 安全課，但任何方法

cues.en: requires a deep understanding of architectures, training and analysis methods for identifying representations
cues.zh: 都需要深入理解架構、訓練、分析，辨識內部表徵

cues.en: and calculations inside the model.
cues.zh: 與計算。

cues.en: So I would say that this course provides a solid foundation if you are interested in pursuing technical AI safety.
cues.zh: 所以，對想走技術性 AI 安全的人，這提供扎實基礎。

cues.en: I think you will agree that almost every sentence I said in this video could be unpacked into a much larger discussion.
cues.zh: 我想你會同意，這支幾乎每句都能展開成更大討論。

cues.en: As I mentioned in the beginning of this video, AI safety is such an important topic, but it's also
cues.zh: 如開頭所說，AI 安全重要，

cues.en: a really big and multifaceted and complex set of issues at the intersection of many other disciplines.
cues.zh: 也是規模大、多面向、複雜，與許多學科交會的問題。

cues.en: Anyway, I hope you feel like this video provided a good summary introduction to the topic.
cues.zh: 希望這支是個好的概括入門。
